  13. 步骤13：subtract(v12(divide), 1.0) → 减法：x - y

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 close：close
  2. 计算 low：low
  3. 计算 prior_peak：close.滚动窗口(30, min_periods=30).max().shift(5)
  4. 计算 drawdown_depth：(1.0 - close.shift(5) / prior_peak).clip(lower=0.0, upper=0.8)
  5. 计算 prior_low：low.滚动窗口(15, min_periods=15).min().shift(1)
  6. 计算 recovery：close / prior_low - 1.0
  7. 计算 recovery_score：recovery.ewm(span=6, adjust=False, min_periods=6).mean() - 0.5 * drawdown_depth
  8. 计算 factor：np.tanh(2.0 * recovery_score) * (0.75 + 0.75 * drawdown_depth)
⚠ 该因子原始 IC 为负，已整体取反（×(-1)）调正方向；下列步骤展示的是原始公式的计算过程。

"kw">class="kw">def factor_recovery_drawdown_saturated(df): """Measure persistent recovery ">class="kw">from a prior drawdown with bounded recovery amplitude.""" df_copy = df.copy() close = df_copy["close"] low = df_copy["low"] prior_peak = close.rolling(30, min_periods=30).max().shift(5) drawdown_depth = (1.0 - close.shift(5) / prior_peak).clip(lower=0.0, upper=0.8) prior_low = low.rolling(15, min_periods=15).min().shift(1).replace(0.0, np.nan) recovery = close / prior_low - 1.0 recovery_score = recovery.ewm(span=6, adjust="kw">class="kw">False, min_periods=6).mean() - 0.5 * drawdown_depth factor = np.tanh(2.0 * recovery_score) * (0.75 + 0.75 * drawdown_depth) df_copy["factor_recovery_drawdown_saturated"] = factor "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["factor_recovery_drawdown_saturated"]
